Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.implicit

Class LegacyImplicitConfiguration

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.implicit.LegacyImplicitConfiguration
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.web.servlet.config.annotation.WebMvcConfigurer
@Profile("legacy-implicit") @Configuration(proxyBeanMethods=false) @EnableConfigurationProperties(LegacyImplicitProperties.class) public class LegacyImplicitConfiguration extends Object implements org.springframework.web.servlet.config.annotation.WebMvcConfigurer
Enables the legacy implicit flow. It exists only under the legacy-implicit profile, as a demonstration of the risks that made OAuth 2.1 remove it, and never in a deployment: the authorization endpoint accepts response_type=token for one client, the client is seeded, and a demo page is served.
